_: Per-page prose ceilings, in words a reader is SHOWN — text-audit.mjs's rendered count: everything in the panel except tables (data), controls and their labels, headings, and anything hidden or sr-only. Text inside a closed 'How this works' toggle is counted separately and is NOT capped here; putting an explanation behind the toggle is the house shape (rule 16), so the ceiling is on what a reader is made to read.
how: Enforced by `node text-audit.mjs`, which runs in npm test. A page may lose words freely. Growing past its ceiling fails the suite on purpose: raising a number here is Tim's call, not a drift. Re-measure with `node text-audit.mjs` and put the new figure in.
